findings.title: Team admin/owner check uses AND instead of OR
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed as isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...). Team admins who are not owners (and, depending on the helpers' role checks, potentially all non-owner admins) therefore fail this test and receive FORBIDDEN unless they are also the organizer or an attendee, so the team-admin path the variable name promises does not work. The two checks should be combined with OR.

findings.title: Guests can be added to cancelled, rejected, pending, or past bookings
findings.body: After the permission check the handler unconditionally creates attendees, updates the calendar event, and sends confirmation-style emails, without checking booking.status or that the booking is in the future. Adding guests to a CANCELLED/REJECTED/PENDING or already-ended booking persists bogus attendees and emits AttendeeScheduled/AddGuests emails with CONFIRMED ICS invites for an event that is not a confirmed future event.

findings.title: Duplicate and blacklist filtering is case-sensitive and ignores duplicates within the request
findings.body: uniqueGuests only removes a guest when guest === attendee.email exactly and when blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest) exactly, even though the blacklist entries were lower-cased. Case variants such as Guest@Example.com vs guest@example.com are treated as new, and two identical (or case-variant) emails inside the same guests array both pass because the filter never de-duplicates the input against itself; createMany then inserts duplicate Attendee rows and duplicate calendar/email recipients.

findings.title: Guests array is unbounded
findings.body: guests is z.array(z.string().email()) with no min/max or uniqueness constraint. Any authorized caller (including a mere attendee of the booking) can submit thousands of addresses in one request, causing thousands of Attendee rows, a getTranslation call per attendee, a calendar-attendee update, and an email fan-out to the organizer, team, and every attendee. A reasonable cap (and server-side uniqueness) is needed.

findings.title: Email classification uses the raw guests list instead of the filtered uniqueGuests
findings.body: The handler filters the request into uniqueGuests for insertion but then calls sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) with the original list. sendAddGuestsEmails decides who is a 'new' guest via newGuests.includes(attendee.email), so an address that was filtered out because the person is already an attendee is misclassified as newly added and receives an AttendeeScheduledEmail instead of the AttendeeAddGuestsEmail sent to other existing attendees. Pass uniqueGuests instead.

findings.title: Calendar update uses the caller's credentials rather than the booking organizer's
findings.body: EventManager is built from getUsersCredentials(ctx.user) and {...user}, i.e. whoever called the mutation. The handler explicitly authorizes team admins/owners and attendees, but for those callers their credentials will not contain the organizer's calendar credential (the booking query even loads booking.user.credentials, which are then ignored), so updateCalendarAttendees cannot update the organizer's calendar event while the database rows and notification emails still go out, leaving calendar invites inconsistent with the booking.

findings.title: sendAddGuestsEmails ignores disabled standard emails configuration
findings.body: Unlike the other send* functions in this file, sendAddGuestsEmails accepts no eventTypeMetadata and never checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail/eventTypeDisableAttendeeEmail, and the handler does not pass booking.eventType.metadata. Event types that have disabled standard host/attendee emails will still send organizer, team, and attendee emails when guests are added.

findings.title: Invalid-email error state is not cleared after success or manual close
findings.body: isInvalidEmail is set to true on a failed validation but onSuccess only resets multiEmailValue, and closing via Dialog onOpenChange (the X/Escape path calling setIsOpenDialog directly) resets neither value. After fixing the input and successfully adding guests, or after dismissing the dialog, reopening it can immediately show the stale 'Emails must be unique and valid' error before the user types anything.
